card.text: The Pleiades is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 135 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), Melotte_22: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 134.84134308 pc (16th to 84th percentile 134.82 to 134.86)

introduction.text: The Pleiades is drawn as 1,020 of its member stars, measured by Gaia and, for its nine named stars, by Hipparcos; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
